description: The NASDAQ-100 ranked best to worst on the session: price, change and sector for every stock. Pass symbol to ask about ONE company instead, like AAPL or NVDA, and you get its price, its move on the session and where it ranks on the board today. Equities are market data: live on Pro and Ultimate, upgrade steps instead of numbers below.

symbol.description: One or more NASDAQ-100 tickers, comma separated, like AAPL or AAPL,MSFT. Empty returns the whole ranked board.
